meta.title: Serigne Saliou Mbacké Mbaye — AI & Remote Sensing Research Engineer
meta.description: Research Engineer in AI and satellite remote sensing for agriculture: crop yield estimation, crop classification and phenology with Google Earth Engine and machine learning. Open to PhD supervision, research collaborations and freelance missions.

about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm an AI Research Engineer 🧠 and fullstack developer 🔧 specializing in AI, satellite remote sensing, and agricultural applications. My work focuses on crop yield estimation, classification, phenology, and geospatial analysis using Google Earth Engine and machine learning. I build scalable solutions that turn research and data into practical applications.
